description: Expander for MIX4 — a three-band EQ for each of its four channels, two sends, and two stereo returns

params.text: Sets the gain of that channel's 100Hz band, -36dB through unity at noon to +12dB
Sets the gain of that channel's 350Hz band, -36dB through unity at noon to +12dB
Sets the gain of that channel's 1000Hz band, -36dB through unity at noon to +12dB
Sets how much of that channel goes to that send, linear in decibels
Takes the signal before the channel's fader, mute and EQ rather than after
Sets the level of that return into the master stage

inputs.text: 0-10V attenuated by that send's knob, setting how much of that channel reaches the send
The left side of that return, mixed into the MIX4's master stage
The right side of that return; with nothing patched here, the left input feeds both sides
0-10V attenuated by the A return's LEVEL knob

outputs.text: The four channels summed at their knob settings for that send

notes: goes immediately to the right of its MIX4
